# randino

> A random text generator for sample data. Made-up person names, nicknames, words and whole sentences in nine languages, shipped for JavaScript, Dart and Python with no runtime dependencies.

randino generates random text for sample data, in nine languages.
**Person names** read like names a person actually carries (김민준, Emma Clover).
**Nicknames** are the handles someone would pick for a game or a website (멋진사자, MistyOwl),
built from everyday words and never from person names. **Words** are those everyday words on
their own, across twenty-nine themes. **Sentences** are whole statements in the language's own
grammar (여우가 사과를 먹는다). **Locations** are real places written out down to a Korean 읍·면·동
or a US city, in the two languages whose countries publish that list free of conditions, beside
every country's name in all nine. **Ages** are whole numbers drawn along a curve shaped like a
population, **genders** are the labels a form in the language writes (여성, Female),
**organizations** are companies, schools and offices that do not exist ((주)새솔테크),
**dates** are drawn from a range and written out by a format, or one part at a time,
**phone numbers** are written the way their country writes them and can by chance be real
ones, **system values** describe a sample machine with real operating systems, devices,
processors and graphics (Windows 11, Apple iPhone 15 Pro, Intel Core i7-13700K, NVIDIA GeForce
RTX 4090), the architecture they run (x86_64), the memory and storage they are sold with
(16 GB, 1 TB SSD), the size of their screen (1920x1080) and the version numbers of their
software (2.14.3, 2024.3.1), the store it came from (Google Play Store) and the extensions
of its files and the MIME types they are served as (.pdf, application/pdf),
and **decorators** attach a token or a modifier to a string you already have.

The same library ships as three packages (`randino` on npm, on pub.dev and on PyPI), generating
the same output from the same datasets. **Everything below is the JavaScript package**, which is
the reference implementation. The other two differ only in how options are passed: Dart takes
named parameters (`randName(language: NameLanguage.ko)`), and Python takes keyword arguments with
snake_case names (`rand_name(language="ko")`, `min_length`, `include_middle_name`).

Every page below also exists in Korean at the same path under `/ko/`.

## Guide

- [Demo](https://randino.cdget.com/demo): Everything below runs in your browser. The controls are the options randName, randNickname, randWord, randSentence, randLocation, randAge, randGender,…
- [Getting started](https://randino.cdget.com/guide/getting-started): randino ships as three packages from one set of datasets. Pick your language in the sidebar, and every code sample on this site follows that choice, including…
- [Supported languages](https://randino.cdget.com/guide/languages): randino generates in nine languages, each with its own pools, its own name order and its own romanization. Every generator takes a language, and mixes all of…

## API: Generators: General

- [randName](https://randino.cdget.com/name/rand-name): Generates person names and returns count of them as strings, written in the script you asked for. With output: 'detail' it returns the native and romanized…
- [randNickname](https://randino.cdget.com/nickname/rand-nickname): Generates nicknames and returns count of them as strings. Each one is an everyday word with something added to it: an adjective in front, a verb in front, a…
- [randWord](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-word): Generates everyday words and returns count of them as strings. Animals, things, nature and ideas, across twenty-nine themes in nine languages, and never a…
- [randSentence](https://randino.cdget.com/sentence/rand-sentence): Generates whole sentences and returns count of them as strings. Each one is a subject and something said about it, written the way the language writes it: the…
- [randLocation](https://randino.cdget.com/location/rand-location): Generates real locations and returns count of them as strings, each written out from the country down to the level you ask for, the way its language writes a…
- [randAge](https://randino.cdget.com/age/rand-age): Generates ages for sample people and returns count of them as whole numbers of years. The draw follows a curve shaped like a population rather than an even…
- [randGender](https://randino.cdget.com/gender/rand-gender): Generates genders for sample people and returns count of them as strings, written the way a form in the language labels them: 여성, Female, Weiblich. Male and…
- [randOrganization](https://randino.cdget.com/organization/rand-organization): Generates the names of organizations that do not exist and returns count of them as strings: companies, schools, government offices, public institutions and…
- [randDate](https://randino.cdget.com/date/rand-date): Generates dates and returns count of them, each drawn evenly from a range and written out in UTC or at the offset you name. The default range is the years 1900…
- [randPhone](https://randino.cdget.com/phone/rand-phone): Generates phone numbers and returns count of them, written the way their country writes them: 010-4821-3967 in Korea, (415) 726-0193 in the United States, 8…

## API: Generators: System

- [randOs](https://randino.cdget.com/os/rand-os): Generates real operating systems and returns count of them, each written the way its release is known: Windows 11, macOS Sonoma 14, Android 9 Pie. Nothing is…
- [randDevice](https://randino.cdget.com/device/rand-device): Generates real phones, tablets and laptops and returns count of them, each by the name its maker gave it: Apple iPhone 15 Pro, Samsung Galaxy Tab S9, Lenovo…
- [randRam](https://randino.cdget.com/ram/rand-ram): Generates amounts of memory and returns count of them, written the way a spec sheet writes them: 16 GB, 8 GB, 512 MB. Every size is one a phone, a laptop, a…
- [randDiskType](https://randino.cdget.com/disk/rand-disk-type): Generates the kind of storage a machine has and returns count of them, written the way a spec sheet labels it: SSD, HDD, UFS. Each kind comes up by how common…
- [randDiskSize](https://randino.cdget.com/disk/rand-disk-size): Generates drive capacities and returns count of them, written the way a box or a spec sheet writes them: 512 GB, 1 TB, 4 TB. Every size is one a drive or a…
- [randCpu](https://randino.cdget.com/cpu/rand-cpu): Generates real processors and returns count of them, each by the name its maker gave it: Intel Core i7-13700K, AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, Apple M3 Pro, Qualcomm…
- [randGpu](https://randino.cdget.com/gpu/rand-gpu): Generates real graphics processors and returns count of them, each by the name its maker gave it: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX, Intel Iris…
- [randArchitecture](https://randino.cdget.com/architecture/rand-architecture): Generates processor architectures and returns count of them, by the name a download page most often lists them under: x86_64, arm64, x86, armv7. Nearly every…
- [randResolution](https://randino.cdget.com/resolution/rand-resolution): Generates screen resolutions and returns count of them, written as the width, an x and the height: 1920x1080, 2560x1440, 390x844. They are the sizes people's…
- [randVersion](https://randino.cdget.com/version/rand-version): Generates software version numbers and returns count of them, in one of three formats: a semantic version (2.14.3), a calendar version counted from a year…
- [randAppStore](https://randino.cdget.com/appstore/rand-app-store): Generates real app stores and returns count of them, by the name each is known by, with its company in front where the store is called by one: Google Play…
- [randFileExtension](https://randino.cdget.com/file/rand-file-extension): Generates file extensions and returns count of them, each one an extension files are really saved with: .pdf, .png, .mp4, .zip, .js. The extensions nearly…
- [randMimeType](https://randino.cdget.com/file/rand-mime-type): Generates MIME types and returns count of them, each one a type files are really served as: application/pdf, image/png, video/mp4. They are the types…

## API: Generators: Locations

- [randCountry](https://randino.cdget.com/location/rand-country): Generates country names and returns count of them as strings: every country and territory ISO 3166-1 gives a code, 249 of them, named the way the language…
- [randRegion](https://randino.cdget.com/location/rand-region): A country's first-level divisions: a Korean 시·도, or a US state or the District of Columbia. Each is drawn as often as any other, whatever its size.
- [randCity](https://randino.cdget.com/location/rand-city): The divisions a region is made of: a Korean 시·군·구, or a US city, town, village or census designated place.
- [randDistrict](https://randino.cdget.com/location/rand-district): The divisions inside a city: a Korean 읍·면·동. It is the legal 동 an address is written with rather than the administrative 동 a community centre serves, and never…

## API: Generators: Words

- [randAnimal](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-animal): Animals, the creatures a nickname is most often built around.
- [randObject](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-object): Everyday things: what is on a desk, in a bag, around a house.
- [randNature](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-nature): Nature and its phenomena: sky, weather, water and land.
- [randPlant](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-plant): Plants: trees, flowers, leaves and what grows on them.
- [randGem](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-gem): Stones and metals, precious and ordinary alike.
- [randConcept](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-concept): Ideas out of the humanities and the social world.
- [randMyth](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-myth): Creatures and figures out of myth and folklore.
- [randJob](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-job): The trades and roles people hold. Never a person name, which is why there is no Baker or Hunter here.
- [randMusic](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-music): Music: instruments, forms and the words around them.
- [randPlace](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-place): Places where people gather, live and pass through.
- [randFood](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-food): Food and drink, the everyday kind.
- [randSport](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-sport): Sports and the things people play.
- [randVehicle](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-vehicle): Things that carry you.
- [randProduct](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-product): Things you buy, the manufactured end of the vocabulary.
- [randColor](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-color): Colours, from the plain ones to the ones with a history.
- [randFinance](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-finance): Money, and the words for what is done with it.
- [randTech](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-tech): The vocabulary of computers and the networks between them.
- [randWeather](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-weather): What the sky is doing, from a breeze to a blizzard.
- [randSpace](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-space): What is beyond the sky, from the moon to a galaxy.
- [randTime](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-time): When something happens, from a moment to a season.
- [randEmotion](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-emotion): What someone feels, from joy to a quiet regret.
- [randBody](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-body): The parts of a body, inside and out.
- [randClothing](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-clothing): What people wear, and what it is made of.
- [randTool](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-tool): What a hand works with, from a chisel to a plough.
- [randDrink](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-drink): Something to drink, hot, cold or fermented.
- [randToy](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-toy): Toys and games, the things and the play a childhood is made of.
- [randSound](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-sound): Sounds and voices, and the words a language has for them.
- [randPerson](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-person): People by age, kinship and character, never by trade and never by name.
- [randFurniture](https://randino.cdget.com/word/rand-furniture): Furniture and the furnishings of a home.

## API: Decorators

- [randSuffix](https://randino.cdget.com/decorate/rand-suffix): Appends a random token to a string, or to every string in an array, so MistyOwl becomes MistyOwl_nVtRC. It turns a nickname two people are fairly likely to…
- [randPrefix](https://randino.cdget.com/decorate/rand-prefix): Prepends a random token to a string, or to every string in an array. It mirrors randSuffix, for the places where the distinguishing part belongs in front: a…
- [randModifier](https://randino.cdget.com/decorate/rand-modifier): Puts a random modifier in front of a string, or of every string in an array, so Owl becomes MistyOwl. It takes any string rather than only this library's…

## API: Utilities

- [nameLengthRange](https://randino.cdget.com/name/name-length-range): The natural length range of a full name in that language, in characters of the native form. This is what randName falls back to when minLength or maxLength is…
- [nameSupportsMiddleName](https://randino.cdget.com/name/name-supports-middle-name): Whether the language uses a middle name at all. Korean, Japanese and Chinese names have no middle part, so includeMiddleName is ignored for them. Like the two…
- [nameSupportsRoman](https://randino.cdget.com/name/name-supports-roman): Whether asking for the romanized script produces anything different from the native one. Only English answers false, because its names are already written in…
- [nicknameLengthRange](https://randino.cdget.com/nickname/nickname-length-range): Every nickname length the language can produce, in characters. This is what randNickname falls back to when minLength or maxLength is omitted.
- [sentenceLengthRange](https://randino.cdget.com/sentence/sentence-length-range): Every sentence length the language can produce, in characters. That is what randSentence falls back to when minLength or maxLength is omitted.
- [wordLengthRange](https://randino.cdget.com/word/word-length-range): Reports the shortest and longest word a language's pools hold, in characters. This is what randWord falls back to when minLength or maxLength is left out.

## Behaviour

- [Person names](https://randino.cdget.com/name/): randino generates names people carry, such as Emma Clover and Jack Reeves, in nine languages, each in its own script and with its English pronunciation…
- [Nicknames](https://randino.cdget.com/nickname/): A nickname is the handle someone would pick for a game or a website: MistyOwl, CraneVoyage, RustyBoot. randino builds one out of an everyday word with…
- [Sentences](https://randino.cdget.com/sentence/): randSentence writes a whole statement rather than a name or a handle: a subject, and something said about it. This page is how it decides what may stand where.…
